name: [FREE UGC] World of Trollge
desc:
Welcome to the OFFICIAL World of Trolls!
We're thrilled to have you here, and we hope you enjoy your stay in the chaotic world of trolls! 😈👹

Join our Roblox group for the exclusive WoT Enjoyer tag and connect with other fans of the game!

📜 Rules of the Realm: 🚫 No Exploiting – Cheating will result in a permanent ban.
🐛 No Bug Abuse – Abusing glitches can lead to a week-long ban or more for repeat offenses.
🛑 No Ban Evasion – If you’re banned, stay banned! Evading a ban will result in a permanent ban with no second chances.
📜 Follow Roblox ToS – Breaking Roblox’s Terms of Service (e.g., Cross-trading, Gambling) may result in a ban from the game.

Unban Appeals: Think you’ve been banned unfairly? Join our community server to submit an appeal. Remember, you’re responsible for your own account – any actions by family or friends using your account will still count against you.

🎶 Music Credits 🎶
Special thanks to GR8_REX for their awesome music tracks!
